question: 2026학년도 1학기 IE419-00(서비스데이터사이언스)와 2026학년도 1학기 SWCON104-01(웹/파이선프로그래밍)의 정규 수업시간이 일주일에 총 몇 분 겹쳐? 시험 일정은 제외하고 요일별 겹치는 구간만 합산해줘.

WITH c1 AS (
    SELECT
        ts.day,
        CAST(SUBSTR(ts.start_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(ts.start_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_min,
        CAST(SUBSTR(ts.end_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(ts.end_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) AS end_min
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN class_times ct ON co.offering_id = ct.offering_id
    JOIN time_slots ts ON ct.time_slot_id = ts.time_slot_id
    WHERE co.year = 2026
      AND co.semester = '1'
      AND co.course_code = 'IE419'
      AND co.section = '00'
),
c2 AS (
    SELECT
        ts.day,
        CAST(SUBSTR(ts.start_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(ts.start_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_min,
        CAST(SUBSTR(ts.end_time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(ts.end_time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) AS end_min
    FROM course_offerings co
    JOIN class_times ct ON co.offering_id = ct.offering_id
    JOIN time_slots ts ON ct.time_slot_id = ts.time_slot_id
    WHERE co.year = 2026
      AND co.semester = '1'
      AND co.course_code = 'SWCON104'
      AND co.section = '01'
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN (CASE WHEN c1.end_min < c2.end_min THEN c1.end_min ELSE c2.end_min END) >
                 (CASE WHEN c1.start_min > c2.start_min THEN c1.start_min ELSE c2.start_min END)
            THEN (CASE WHEN c1.end_min < c2.end_min THEN c1.end_min ELSE c2.end_min END) -
                 (CASE WHEN c1.start_min > c2.start_min THEN c1.start_min ELSE c2.start_min END)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ), 0) AS total_overlap_minutes
FROM c1
JOIN c2 ON c1.day = c2.day;
